acceptance_criteria.description: Every successful audit executes a genuine rg binary with working PCRE2; unavailable ambient and managed rg fail nonzero
Ambient and managed-ripgrep paths fail closed on invalid UTF-8 source bytes
The authority receipt records the exact reviewed audit script SHA-256 and byte size
The pinned external HCP commit, contract, and authority document digests remain unchanged
The clean GitHub required gate verifies the same script and receipt bytes

objective: Keep the binding rg plus PCRE2 audit semantics on clean runners by resolving a version-pinned genuine ripgrep binary through uv when ambient rg is unavailable, then bind the reviewed script bytes without changing external HCP authority.
title: Bind managed ripgrep audit receipt
